title: What mass spectrometry measures
summary: From molecules to ions to evidence: understand what a mass spectrum can—and cannot—tell you.
text: The central idea Mass spectrometry (MS) studies matter by producing gas-phase ions and measuring signals associated with their mass-to-charge ratios, written m/z . A neutral molecule must become an ion before it can be manipulated by electric fields. The detected ion is not necessarily the original molecule: it may have gained a proton, acquired an adduct, or broken into fragments. IUPAC provides the terminology used throughout this wiki. [1] A mass spectrum places m/z on the horizontal axis and signal intensity on the vertical axis. Each peak represents an ion population within a small measurement interval. It is evidence about a sample, interpreted through an instrument and a method. Follow the measurement Prepare and introduce the sample. Extraction, dilution, and chromatography determine which material reaches the source. Form ions. Ionization chemistry determines which charged species are produced. Transfer and analyze. Ion optics transmit part of that population; an analyzer distinguishes ions by m/z . Detect and process. Detector signals become peaks, chromatographic features, and candidate identifications. In liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC–MS), spectra are acquired repeatedly as compounds elute. A spectrum describes a moment or time interval; a chromatogram follows signal over time. An extracted-ion chromatogram (XIC) follows a selected m/z interval. These views answer different questions. Worked example: one compound, several peaks Suppose a neutral compound has a monoisotopic mass of 300.0000 Da. In positive electrospray it might produce a protonated ion, [M+H] + , near m/z 301.0073 and a sodium adduct, [M+Na] + , near 322.9892. Heavier isotopes can add further peaks. Several peaks therefore need not mean several compounds. Conversely, two compounds can produce ions at the same nominal or even exact m/z . Structural isomers can share a formula. Separation, fragmentation, standards, and other evidence help distinguish them. Signal is not automatically concentration Response depends on ionization efficiency, matrix effects, transmission, acquisition settings, and detector behavior. A peak twice as high does not by itself establish twice the concentration across different compounds. Quantification needs a defined response model, suitable calibration, quality controls, and often an internal standard. Reference spectra help evaluate identity, but the ionization and fragmentation conditions must be compatible. NIST maintains distinct electron-ionization and tandem-MS reference libraries, reflecting that difference. [2] Check your understanding Does the tallest peak have to be the molecular ion? No. It is the base peak—the most intense peak in that spectrum. It could be a fragment, an adduct, a contaminant, or another ion. Its intensity alone does not establish identity. Beyond the basics For computational work, keep the measurement layers separate: a centroid peak, a chromatographic feature, an ion assignment, and a molecular identification are different objects. Trace every processed result back to the scan, sample, and processing parameters that produced it.

title: 质谱测量的是什么
summary: 从分子到离子，再到证据：理解质谱能够回答和无法单独回答的问题。
text: 核心概念 质谱（MS）通过生成气相离子并测量与其质荷比（ m/z ）相关的信号来研究物质。中性分子需要先转变为离子，才能被电场操控。检测到的离子不一定就是原始分子：它可能接受了质子、形成了加合物，或发生了碎裂。本知识库的术语以 IUPAC 的建议为基础。 [1] 质谱图的横轴是 m/z ，纵轴是信号强度。每个峰表示一个较小测量区间内的离子群。质谱是关于样品的证据，需要结合仪器与实验方法解释。 沿着测量流程理解 样品处理与引入。 提取、稀释和色谱分离决定哪些物质到达离子源。 形成离子。 电离过程决定产生哪些带电物种。 传输与分析。 离子光学系统传输其中一部分离子，质量分析器按 m/z 区分它们。 检测与处理。 检测信号转换为谱峰、色谱特征和候选鉴定结果。 在液相色谱–质谱（LC–MS）中，化合物洗脱时仪器连续采集质谱。质谱图描述某个时刻或时间区间；色谱图描述信号随时间的变化。提取离子色谱图（XIC）跟踪选定 m/z 范围的信号。它们回答不同的问题。 计算示例：一个化合物，多个峰 假设某中性化合物的单同位素质量是 300.0000 Da。在正离子电喷雾中，它可能形成质子化离子 [M+H] + ，位于 m/z 301.0073 附近；也可能形成钠加合离子 [M+Na] + ，位于 322.9892 附近。较重同位素还会产生其他峰。因此，多个峰并不一定代表多个化合物。 反过来，不同化合物也可能形成标称质荷比甚至精确质荷比相同的离子。结构异构体可以具有相同分子式。分离、碎裂、标准品及其他证据有助于区分它们。 信号不直接等于浓度 响应受到电离效率、基质效应、传输、采集设置和检测器行为的影响。对于不同化合物，峰高相差两倍并不能直接证明浓度相差两倍。定量需要明确的响应模型、合适的校准和质量控制，通常还需要内标。 参考谱图可以帮助评价身份，但电离和碎裂条件需要匹配。NIST 分别维护电子电离和串联质谱参考库，体现了二者的区别。 [2] 理解检查 最高的峰一定是分子离子峰吗？ 不是。它是基峰，即该谱图中强度最高的峰。它可能是碎片、加合物、污染物或其他离子。仅靠强度不能确定其身份。 进一步学习 在计算分析中，应区分质心峰、色谱特征、离子指认和分子鉴定这几个层次。每个处理结果都应该能够追溯到对应的扫描、样品和处理参数。

title: m/z, charge & isotopes
summary: Calculate charged-ion masses and build an isotope distribution, then connect both to measurement quality.
text: Start with the ion, not the neutral molecule An ion’s mass and charge jointly determine its position on a mass spectrum. The conventional horizontal coordinate m/z is dimensionless: divide the ion mass expressed in daltons by the magnitude of its charge number. It is not the physical ratio in kg/C, and an axis labeled m/z should not be labeled Da. State positive or negative polarity separately. This follows the IUPAC convention. [1] For the arithmetic below, let x denote that numerical coordinate, M the neutral monoisotopic mass, μ = M/Da its numerical value, and n = |z| the positive integer charge magnitude. Let h = 1.007276467 , the proton mass in Da rounded from NIST CODATA. [3] We neglect binding-energy mass corrections at this teaching precision. Proton-only ion formulas; M refers to the same neutral species Ion Coordinate x Recover neutral mass M [M+nH] n+ (μ + nh) / n (nx − nh) Da [M−nH] n− (μ − nh) / n (nx + nh) Da These expressions describe addition or removal of protons. A sodium adduct, a radical ion formed by electron loss, and a mixed-adduct ion require different compositions. Do not substitute the neutral hydrogen-atom mass (about 1.007825032 Da) for the proton mass. Neutral hydrogen includes an electron; the difference is about 0.0005486 Da. The atomic-mass and particle-mass tables describe different entities. [2] [3] Worked example: one mass, several charge states Assume a hypothetical neutral species with M = 1000.000000 Da forms only protonated ions. The predicted positions are: Ion n Predicted m/z [M+H] + 1 1001.007276 [M+2H] 2+ 2 501.007276 [M+3H] 3+ 3 334.340610 Use the unrounded coordinate for inverse calculations: M = (2 × 501.007276467 − 2 × 1.007276467) Da = 1000.000000 Da . A triply deprotonated ion of the same assumed neutral mass would instead occur near m/z 332.326057. Negative polarity does not require plotting a negative horizontal coordinate. The lower-positioned ion need not be the smaller molecule. Equally, one isolated peak cannot determine both mass and charge: charge needs independent evidence, such as a resolved isotope pattern or related charge states. Isotope spacing helps infer charge Replacing one 12 C by 13 C adds 1.00335483507 Da. Thus, for corresponding carbon-isotope peaks of the same ion, Δx = 1.00335483507 / n . NIST supplies the isotope masses. [4] At n = 1, 2, and 3, the spacings are about 1.003355, 0.501677, and 0.334452, respectively. Compare several intervals before assigning charge; overlapping envelopes or missing peaks can mimic another spacing. An isotopologue differs in isotope composition. The monoisotopic mass is calculated with specified isotopes, conventionally the most abundant isotopes in common organic-MS work. The average mass weights isotope compositions by abundance. The monoisotopic peak is not necessarily the base peak (the most intense peak). Do not use an average mass as a monoisotopic search target. Build an isotope distribution from probabilities Here is an intentionally simplified model: a molecule has N carbon atoms, each independently 13 C with fixed probability p = 0.0107 and otherwise 12 C. Hold all other elements at fixed isotopes and ignore radioactive carbon. The value of p is a representative NIST composition, not a universal constant for every sample. [4] If K is the number of 13 C atoms, its binomial probability is P(K=k) = C(N,k) pᵏ (1−p)ᴺ⁻ᵏ , for integers 0 ≤ k ≤ N. Here C(N,k) = N! / (k! (N−k)!) counts the possible placements. This is our calculation from the stated model, not an experimentally measured distribution. Carbon-only model: percentage of molecules in each isotope class Carbon atoms N k = 0 k = 1 k = 2 10 89.8008% 9.7126% 0.4727% 100 34.1037% 36.8856% 19.7478% Other k values hold the remaining probability. For N = 100, the k = 1 class is more abundant than k = 0: the monoisotopic peak is not the tallest in this model. Also distinguish a fraction of the total from a ratio to the monoisotopic peak . For N = 10, P(1)/P(0) = Np/(1−p) ≈ 0.108157 ; the M+1 signal is about 10.8157% of M, not 9.7126% of M. The labels M, M+1, and M+2 here denote nominal isotope classes, not exact increments of 1 Da or 1 in m/z . A real molecular envelope combines isotopes of every element. For example, M+2 can include two 13 C atoms or one heavy oxygen isotope at different exact masses. Sufficient resolving power can reveal this isotope fine structure; an unresolved nominal class can contain several contributions. Connect the pattern to measurement quality Charge inference depends on peak separation. A narrow-looking centroid stick has no displayed profile width, so it cannot establish resolving power. Likewise, a plausible isotope pattern does not certify the absolute mass calibration. See resolving power versus mass accuracy for definitions and the annotated simulated spectrum to combine charge, isotope ratios, and mass error. Common misconceptions “Every peak is a compound.” One compound can produce several charge states, adducts, isotopologues, and fragments. “The first visible isotope peak must be monoisotopic.” The true monoisotopic peak may be below detection or obscured. “M+1 directly counts carbon atoms.” The approximation assumes a carbon-dominated, interference-free pattern with suitable abundance and response assumptions; other isotopes contribute in real samples. “An exact isotope match proves identity.” It supports a composition hypothesis, but structural isomers can share the same distribution. Check your understanding Three successive carbon-isotope peaks are about 0.3345 apart. What is plausible, and what remains unknown? Charge magnitude 3 is plausible because 1.00335483507 / 3 ≈ 0.334452. Polarity, adduct composition, the monoisotopic assignment, and molecular identity still need evidence. The spacing alone does not supply them. Beyond the basics Deisotoping groups isotopic peaks of an ion. Charge deconvolution combines evidence across charge states to estimate neutral masses. Preserve the original data and document isotope models, abundance assumptions, tolerances, and adduct rules. Neither operation by itself establishes a molecular identity.

title: 质荷比、电荷与同位素
summary: 计算带电离子的质量并构建同位素分布，再将二者与测量质量联系起来。
text: 从离子出发，而不是从中性分子出发 离子的质量和电荷共同决定它在质谱图上的位置。常用横坐标 m/z 无量纲：将以道尔顿表示的离子质量数值除以电荷数绝对值。它不是以 kg/C 表示的物理比值，标为 m/z 的轴不应再标 Da。正负极性应单独说明。这遵循 IUPAC 的约定。 [1] 下文计算中， x 表示这一坐标数值， M 是中性单同位素质量， μ = M/Da 是其数值， n = |z| 是正整数电荷数绝对值。令 h = 1.007276467 ，即由 NIST CODATA 质子质量取舍得到的以 Da 为单位的数值。 [3] 在这一教学精度下，忽略结合能对应的质量修正。 仅加减质子的离子公式；M 对应同一中性物种 离子 坐标 x 还原中性质量 M [M+nH] n+ (μ + nh) / n (nx − nh) Da [M−nH] n− (μ − nh) / n (nx + nh) Da 这些公式描述加入或移除质子。钠加合物、失去电子形成的自由基离子及混合加合物需要使用不同组成。不要用中性氢原子质量（约 1.007825032 Da）代替质子质量。中性氢包含一个电子，二者相差约 0.0005486 Da。原子质量表与粒子质量表描述的是不同实体。 [2] [3] 计算示例：一种质量，多个电荷态 假设某中性物种的 M = 1000.000000 Da，并且只形成质子化离子。预测位置如下： 离子 n 预测 m/z [M+H] + 1 1001.007276 [M+2H] 2+ 2 501.007276 [M+3H] 3+ 3 334.340610 逆向计算使用未舍入坐标： M = (2 × 501.007276467 − 2 × 1.007276467) Da = 1000.000000 Da 。同一假定中性质量的三重去质子化离子则位于 m/z 332.326057 附近。负极性并不要求横坐标使用负数。 位置更低的离子不一定来自更小的分子。同样，一个孤立峰无法同时确定质量和电荷：需要已分辨的同位素模式或相关电荷态等独立证据来判断电荷。 同位素间距帮助推断电荷 用一个 13 C 替代 12 C，质量增加 1.00335483507 Da。因此，同一离子对应碳同位素峰间的坐标差为 Δx = 1.00335483507 / n 。同位素质量来自 NIST。 [4] 当 n = 1、2、3 时，间距分别约为 1.003355、0.501677、0.334452。赋予电荷前应比较多个间隔；包络重叠或峰缺失可能模拟出另一种间距。 同位素体 在同位素组成上不同。 单同位素 质量使用指定同位素计算；常见有机质谱通常选用各元素最丰度同位素。 平均 质量按丰度对同位素组成加权。单同位素峰不一定是基峰，即强度最高的峰。不要用平均质量作为单同位素搜索目标。 从概率构建同位素分布 考虑一个刻意简化的模型：分子有 N 个碳原子，每个原子独立地以固定概率 p = 0.0107 为 13 C，否则为 12 C。其他元素均固定为指定同位素，忽略放射性碳。p 采用 NIST 的代表性组成，并不是所有样品都适用的普适常数。 [4] 若 K 为 13 C 原子数，其二项分布概率为 P(K=k) = C(N,k) pᵏ (1−p)ᴺ⁻ᵏ ，其中 k 是 0 ≤ k ≤ N 的整数。 C(N,k) = N! / (k! (N−k)!) 表示可能的排列位置组合数。这是根据已说明模型进行的计算，并非实验测得的分布。 仅考虑碳同位素的模型：各类占分子总数的百分比 碳原子数 N k = 0 k = 1 k = 2 10 89.8008% 9.7126% 0.4727% 100 34.1037% 36.8856% 19.7478% 其余概率分布在其他 k 值上。N = 100 时，k = 1 的类别比 k = 0 更丰度，因此模型中的单同位素峰不是最高峰。还要区分 占总数的比例 和 相对于单同位素峰的比值 。N = 10 时， P(1)/P(0) = Np/(1−p) ≈ 0.108157 ；M+1 信号约为 M 的 10.8157%，不是 M 的 9.7126%。 这里的 M、M+1 和 M+2 表示标称同位素类别，不表示精确增加 1 Da，也不表示 m/z 增加 1。真实分子包络综合了各元素的同位素。例如，M+2 中可以同时包含两个 13 C 或一个重氧同位素的贡献，二者精确质量不同。足够的分辨本领可以揭示这种同位素精细结构；未分辨的标称类别则可能合并多种贡献。 将模式与测量质量联系起来 电荷推断依赖峰的分离。看起来很细的质心棒图并未显示轮廓峰宽，因此不能据此确定分辨本领。同样，合理的同位素模式不能证明绝对质量校准准确。定义请参阅 分辨本领与质量准确度 ；结合电荷、同位素比值和质量误差的练习见 带注释的模拟谱图 。 常见误解 “每个峰都是一个化合物。” 一个化合物可以产生多个电荷态、加合物、同位素体和碎片。 “第一个可见同位素峰一定是单同位素峰。” 真正的单同位素峰可能低于检测限或被遮蔽。 “M+1 可以直接给出碳原子数。” 这种近似要求碳主导、无干扰的模式，以及合适的丰度与响应假设；真实样品中其他同位素也会贡献信号。 “同位素完全匹配就能证明身份。” 它支持组成假设，但结构异构体可以具有相同分布。 理解检查 连续三个碳同位素峰间距约 0.3345，可以推断什么，还有什么未知？ 电荷数绝对值为 3 是合理假设，因为 1.00335483507 / 3 ≈ 0.334452。但极性、加合物组成、单同位素峰指认和分子身份仍需要证据。间距本身不能给出这些答案。 进一步学习 去同位素处理对同一离子的同位素峰进行分组；电荷去卷积则结合不同电荷态的证据估计中性质量。应保留原始数据，并记录同位素模型、丰度假设、容差与加合物规则。两种处理都不能独立确立分子身份。

title: How molecules become ions
summary: Compare ESI, MALDI, EI, and APCI by the chemistry they enable—not by a universal ranking.
text: The source shapes what you see An ion source converts sample material into gas-phase ions. Its chemistry affects charge states, adducts, fragmentation, and which compounds are detectable. “Soft” ionization means relatively limited fragmentation under suitable conditions; it does not guarantee an intact molecular ion for every compound. Four useful starting points Method How ions form Typical fit and limitation Electrospray (ESI) A charged liquid spray produces droplets that shrink and yield gas-phase ions. LC-compatible; useful for polar or ionizable molecules, peptides, and proteins. Salts and coeluting material can suppress signal. MALDI A laser irradiates analyte in a matrix that assists desorption and ionization. Useful for biomolecules, polymers, and imaging. Matrix peaks can complicate low-mass regions; sample preparation influences results. Electron ionization (EI) Energetic electrons ionize gas-phase molecules, often producing radical cations and fragments. Common with GC for sufficiently volatile, thermally stable compounds. The molecular ion may be weak or absent. APCI A vaporized sample undergoes atmospheric-pressure reagent-ion chemistry, commonly initiated by a corona discharge. Useful for some less polar LC analytes that tolerate vaporization. Suitability depends on gas-phase chemistry and thermal stability. These are starting points, not exclusive application boundaries. Source design, solvent, additives, polarity, and settings all matter. Consult the instrument method and record them when comparing spectra. Why ESI can reveal large molecules ESI can produce multiply charged ions. This brings large molecules into accessible m/z ranges and produces charge-state distributions rather than one peak per molecule. Fenn and colleagues established ESI as a practical route to large biomolecular ions. [1] A protein envelope must therefore be interpreted with a charge model; its most intense peak is not its neutral mass. Worked example: choose the question first You want to analyze a peptide mixture in aqueous organic solvent. LC–ESI–MS is a plausible starting point because separation and continuous ion production work together. A volatile aroma compound may instead suit GC–EI–MS, where reproducible fragmentation can support reference-library matching. These choices still require standards and method validation for the actual sample. EI reference spectra and ESI tandem spectra are not interchangeable. The starting ions and energy deposition differ; use a compatible library and retain the ionization metadata. NIST provides separate library families. [3] Before concluding that a compound is absent Inspect blanks and standards. Consider incorrect polarity, an unexpected adduct, ion suppression, poor extraction, in-source fragmentation, and an unsuitable mass range. A dilution series can reveal non-proportional response, but it does not isolate every cause. Change one controlled variable at a time. Check your understanding Can a soft source produce fragments? Yes. Source and transfer conditions can activate ions. A fragment generated before precursor selection may be mistaken for a separate analyte unless retention behavior and related ions are examined. Beyond the basics Computational adduct grouping should combine expected mass differences with retention time and peak-shape evidence. Shared elution alone is insufficient in a crowded mixture. For vocabulary and source definitions, use the IUPAC recommendations. [2]

title: 分子如何变成离子
summary: 根据电离过程与适用化学性质比较 ESI、MALDI、EI 和 APCI。
text: 离子源决定了你能看到什么 离子源将样品物质转变为气相离子。其化学过程影响电荷态、加合物、碎裂行为及可检测的化合物范围。“软”电离表示在合适条件下碎裂相对较少，但不能保证每种化合物都产生完整的分子离子。 四种常见起点 方法 离子形成过程 常见应用与局限 电喷雾（ESI） 带电液体喷雾形成液滴，液滴缩小并产生气相离子。 兼容 LC，适合极性或可电离分子、肽和蛋白质。盐和共洗脱物可能抑制信号。 MALDI 激光照射含分析物的基质，基质辅助解吸和电离。 常用于生物分子、聚合物及成像。基质峰可能干扰低质量区域，制样方式会影响结果。 电子电离（EI） 高能电子电离气相分子，常产生自由基阳离子及碎片。 常与 GC 联用，适合具有足够挥发性和热稳定性的化合物。分子离子可能很弱或缺失。 APCI 气化样品在大气压下发生试剂离子反应，通常由电晕放电引发。 适合某些极性较低且能耐受气化的 LC 分析物。效果取决于气相化学和热稳定性。 这些是方法选择的起点，并非排他的应用边界。离子源设计、溶剂、添加剂、极性和参数都会影响结果。比较谱图时，应查阅并记录实际仪器方法。 ESI 为何能分析大分子 ESI 可以产生多电荷离子，使大分子进入仪器可测的质荷比范围，并形成电荷态分布，而不是每个分子只有一个峰。Fenn 等人的工作奠定了利用 ESI 产生大生物分子离子的实践基础。 [1] 因此，解释蛋白质离子包络需要电荷模型，最强峰并非中性质量。 应用示例：先明确问题 如果要分析溶于水和有机溶剂中的肽混合物，LC–ESI–MS 是合理起点，因为分离与连续离子生成可以配合。挥发性香气成分则可能适合 GC–EI–MS，利用可重复的碎裂模式与参考库匹配。对实际样品仍需标准品和方法验证。 EI 参考谱不能与 ESI 串联质谱互换。二者的起始离子和能量沉积不同，应使用匹配的谱库并保留电离元数据。NIST 提供不同的谱库类别。 [3] 认定化合物不存在之前 先检查空白和标准品，并考虑极性错误、意外加合物、离子抑制、提取效率低、源内碎裂及质量范围不合适等情况。稀释系列可发现非线性响应，但不能独立确定所有原因。每次只改变一个受控变量。 理解检查 软电离源也会产生碎片吗？ 会。离子源及传输条件可以激活离子。若不检查保留时间和相关离子，在前体选择之前形成的碎片可能被误认为另一种分析物。 进一步学习 计算加合物分组时，应结合预期质量差、保留时间和峰形证据。在复杂混合物中，仅仅共洗脱并不足够。离子源定义与术语可查阅 IUPAC 建议。 [2]

title: Mass analyzers & resolution
summary: Compare analyzer principles and distinguish peak width, resolving power, mass error, and precision.
text: Different physics, the same coordinate An analyzer relates ion motion to m/z . It does not identify a compound by itself. Instruments often combine analyzers: a quadrupole may select a precursor, a collision cell may fragment it, and a time-of-flight or Orbitrap analyzer may measure products. Compare mechanisms Analyzer Physical idea What to watch Quadrupole Radio-frequency and direct-current fields allow selected ion trajectories to remain stable. Useful as a mass filter. Isolation width and transmission affect selectivity and sensitivity. Time of flight (TOF) After controlled acceleration, flight time depends on mass-to-charge ratio. Timing, initial energy spread, calibration, and ion optics affect peak width and accuracy. Ion trap Fields confine ions; controlled excitation or ejection enables analysis and multiple stages of fragmentation. Ion capacity, space charge, scan conditions, and accessible mass range matter. Orbitrap Axial oscillation frequencies in an electrostatic field encode m/z . Signal observation time and ion population affect performance. FT-ICR Cyclotron motion in a magnetic field produces frequencies related to m/z . Magnetic field, transient duration, and ion interactions influence resolving power. IUPAC defines these analyzer families. [1] Makarov's original Orbitrap paper describes the electrostatic trapping and frequency-based mass-analysis principle. [2] Worked example: a resolution claim A specification states R = 50,000 at m/z 500 using full width at half maximum (FWHM). Let x be the numerical m/z coordinate and w the profile peak width on that same coordinate scale, measured between the two half-height crossings after baseline subtraction. Then R = x / w and w = 500 / 50,000 = 0.010 . R is dimensionless. The width here is a difference in m/z coordinates, not a neutral mass in Da. FWHM and a two-peak valley criterion are different measurement conventions; a resolution number without its convention and reference m/z is incomplete. [1] Two ions separated by 0.004 near 500 may not be adequately distinguished at this width. The ratio 500 / 0.004 = 125,000 merely sets a width scale equal to their separation; it does not guarantee baseline separation. Peak shape, relative intensity, and signal quality matter. Resolving power, mass accuracy, and precision Resolving power concerns the width or separation of peaks. Mass accuracy concerns closeness to a reference value; signed mass error measures a particular deviation. Precision concerns agreement among repeated measurements. Calibration and interference affect the reliability of measured positions, even when peaks are narrow. Official instrument guidance discusses why accuracy must be evaluated under defined conditions. [3] Define x obs as an observed coordinate and x ref as the reference for the same ion composition, charge, and isotope . Then error (ppm) = 10⁶ × (x_obs − x_ref) / x_ref . A positive value means the measured position is too high. Comparing a protonated ion to a neutral mass or the wrong isotope gives a meaningless accuracy assessment. Constructed comparisons at reference m/z 500.0000; FWHM measured from profile data Case Observed m/z FWHM w R = x_obs / w Signed error Narrow, offset 500.0020 0.0100 ≈ 50,000 +4 ppm Broad, centered 500.0000 0.1000 5,000 0 ppm The second case illustrates a zero error for one idealized measurement, not a demonstrated instrument accuracy specification. Repeated positions of 500.0019, 500.0020, and 500.0021 are tightly grouped but still biased high. Repeatability does not remove systematic error, and one favorable measurement cannot establish performance across a mass range. A matching window is not a peak width For a chosen tolerance t in ppm, a symmetric search window around x ref has half-width δ = x_ref × t × 10⁻⁶ . At 500, ±5 ppm means ±0.0025, or 499.9975–500.0025. At 1000, the same tolerance means ±0.0050. A fixed coordinate window and a fixed ppm window therefore behave differently across the spectrum. A tolerance is an analysis decision, not a statement that every accepted match is correct. Do not infer it from the number of displayed decimal places. Use calibration evidence, suitable controls, and the distribution of errors under the relevant method. A centroid list alone does not retain the profile width needed for a FWHM measurement. See the annotated simulated example for a separate view of position offset and width. Performance is a set of tradeoffs Longer transients can improve frequency discrimination in Fourier-transform measurements, but take time. In an LC experiment, the instrument must still sample the chromatographic peak often enough. Higher nominal resolving power is not automatically the best acquisition choice. Mass accuracy concerns deviation from a reference value. Resolving power concerns peak separation. Sensitivity concerns response to analyte amount under a defined method. Dynamic range concerns the usable signal span. Compare them under stated conditions, not as a single ranking of instruments. Check your understanding Does high resolving power eliminate a co-isolated precursor? No. Precursors can enter the same isolation window before high-resolution product measurement. Better product separation can help interpretation, but does not undo the mixed fragmentation event. Beyond the basics Centroiding, Fourier processing, calibration, and peak fitting can change the reported peak list. For algorithm evaluation, retain the acquisition settings and distinguish profile data from centroid data. A benchmark on one analyzer and processing pipeline need not transfer unchanged to another.

title: 质量分析器与分辨率
summary: 比较分析器原理，区分峰宽、分辨本领、质量误差和精密度。
text: 不同物理机制，相同坐标 质量分析器将离子运动与 m/z 联系起来，但它本身不能确定化合物身份。仪器常组合多种部件：四极杆选择前体，碰撞池使其碎裂，飞行时间或 Orbitrap 分析器测量产物离子。 比较分析机制 分析器 物理原理 需要注意 四极杆 射频与直流电场使选定离子的运动轨迹保持稳定。 可作为质量过滤器。隔离宽度和传输效率影响选择性与灵敏度。 飞行时间（TOF） 受控加速后，飞行时间与质荷比相关。 计时、初始能量分布、校准和离子光学影响峰宽与准确度。 离子阱 电场约束离子，通过受控激发或排出来分析，也可进行多级碎裂。 离子容量、空间电荷、扫描条件和可用质量范围很重要。 Orbitrap 静电场中的轴向振荡频率编码质荷比。 信号观察时间和离子数量影响性能。 FT-ICR 磁场中的回旋运动产生与质荷比相关的频率。 磁场、瞬态信号时长和离子相互作用影响分辨本领。 IUPAC 对这些分析器类型作出了定义。 [1] Makarov 的原始 Orbitrap 论文介绍了静电俘获与基于频率的质量分析原理。 [2] 计算示例：解读分辨率指标 某指标给出在 m/z 500 处，采用半峰全宽（FWHM）定义时 R = 50,000。令 x 为质荷比坐标数值，w 为同一坐标尺度上的轮廓峰宽，即扣除基线后两个半峰高交点之间的距离。于是 R = x / w ，且 w = 500 / 50,000 = 0.010 。R 无量纲；这里的峰宽是质荷比坐标差，不是以 Da 表示的中性质量。 FWHM 与两峰之间的谷高标准是不同的测量约定；若未说明定义及参考质荷比，单独的分辨率数值是不完整的。 [1] 在此峰宽下，500 附近相差 0.004 的两个离子可能无法充分区分。500 / 0.004 = 125,000 只是给出一个峰宽等于峰间距的尺度，不能保证基线分离。峰形、相对强度和信号质量都很重要。 分辨本领、质量准确度与精密度 分辨本领关注峰宽或峰的分离。质量准确度关注接近参考值的程度；带符号的质量误差衡量某次具体偏差。精密度关注重复测量之间的一致性。即使峰很窄，校准与干扰仍会影响位置的可靠性。官方仪器指南解释了为什么应在明确条件下评价准确度。 [3] 定义 x obs 为观测坐标， x ref 为 相同离子组成、电荷和同位素 的参考坐标。则 error (ppm) = 10⁶ × (x_obs − x_ref) / x_ref 。正值表示测量位置偏高。若将质子化离子与中性质量或错误同位素比较，所得准确度评价没有意义。 参考 m/z 为 500.0000 的构造比较；FWHM 从轮廓数据测量 情况 观测 m/z FWHM w R = x_obs / w 带符号误差 窄峰，但有偏移 500.0020 0.0100 ≈ 50,000 +4 ppm 宽峰，但中心准确 500.0000 0.1000 5,000 0 ppm 第二种情况只是一次理想化测量误差为零，并不代表已经验证了仪器准确度指标。重复位置 500.0019、500.0020 和 500.0021 十分集中，但仍整体偏高。重复性不能消除系统误差，单个有利结果也不能证明整个质量范围内的性能。 匹配窗口不是峰宽 给定以 ppm 表示的容差 t，以 x ref 为中心的对称搜索窗口半宽为 δ = x_ref × t × 10⁻⁶ 。在 500 处，±5 ppm 表示 ±0.0025，即 499.9975–500.0025；在 1000 处，同一容差表示 ±0.0050。因此，固定坐标窗口和固定 ppm 窗口在不同位置的行为不同。 容差是一项分析决策，并不意味着所有通过窗口的匹配都正确。不能从显示的小数位数推断容差。应参考校准证据、合适对照及相关方法下的误差分布。单独的质心列表不保留测量 FWHM 所需的轮廓峰宽。参阅 带注释的模拟例子 ，分别观察位置偏移与峰宽。 性能需要权衡 在傅里叶变换测量中，更长的瞬态信号通常有利于区分频率，但也消耗时间。LC 实验仍需对色谱峰进行足够密集的采样。因此，更高的标称分辨本领不一定是最优采集选择。 质量准确度关注相对于参考值的偏差；分辨本领关注峰的分离；灵敏度关注既定方法下分析物量与响应的关系；动态范围关注可用信号跨度。比较时应说明条件，而不是用一个指标给仪器排序。 理解检查 高分辨本领能排除共隔离前体吗？ 不能。在高分辨产物测量之前，多个前体可能已经进入同一隔离窗口。产物分离能力有助于解释，但不能撤销已发生的混合碎裂。 进一步学习 质心化、傅里叶处理、校准及峰拟合都可能改变最终峰列表。评价算法时应保留采集参数，并区分轮廓数据和质心数据。在某种分析器和处理流程上的基准结果，不一定能直接推广到另一种情况。

title: Fragmentation & tandem MS
summary: Follow precursor selection, activation, and product-ion evidence without overcalling a structure.
text: Select → activate → measure Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) links precursor ions to product ions. In a common experiment, the instrument isolates an m/z window, activates ions within it, and measures the resulting products. “Precursor” is preferable to assuming a single pure molecule: an isolation window can contain several ion species. [1] Activation changes the evidence Collision-induced dissociation (CID) transfers energy through collisions with a gas. HCD is a widely used implementation of beam-type collisional activation. The observed pattern depends on ion composition, charge, collision energy, and instrument conditions. Energy values from different instruments are not necessarily equivalent. Electron-transfer dissociation (ETD) transfers an electron to a multiply charged cation and can yield complementary backbone cleavages. Its foundational peptide work demonstrated an alternative to collision-based fragmentation. [2] Choosing activation is part of choosing which structural evidence to collect. A first look at peptide ions Peptide backbone fragments are named by the terminus they retain and the bond cleaved. In typical positive-ion collisional spectra, b ions retain the N terminus and y ions retain the C terminus. ETD often produces c and z-type ions. Real spectra can also contain neutral losses, internal fragments, multiple charges, and unassigned peaks. Differences between consecutive singly charged ions in one series can correspond to residue masses. A difference near 71.0371 Da is consistent with an alanine residue in the right context. It does not establish the whole sequence; charge, series assignment, modifications, and mass tolerance must agree. Worked example: neutral loss A singly charged precursor near 301.1000 and a singly charged product near 283.0894 differ by 18.0106, consistent with loss of water. This suggests a possible fragmentation pathway, not a unique molecular identity. Many structures can lose water. For a doubly charged ion retaining its charge, that neutral loss shifts m/z by about 9.0053 instead. Use a pattern, not one diagnostic-looking peak Compare multiple products, neutral losses, precursor composition, and retention behavior. A library match is stronger when ion type and activation conditions agree. NIST's tandem library provides condition-dependent reference spectra rather than a universal spectrum for every molecule. [3] Unexplained intense peaks may indicate co-isolation, contaminants, alternative chemistry, or an incorrect candidate. Do not silently discard them to improve a match. Likewise, missing predicted peaks can reflect detection limits or fragmentation preferences. Check your understanding Does one matching fragment prove a candidate structure? No. Assess the full evidence and plausible alternatives. Fragment matches are often shared among related compounds, and mixed spectra can create misleading combinations. Beyond the basics Fragmentation trees, sequence database searches, spectral prediction, and de novo sequencing formalize these constraints. Evaluate candidate ranking separately from calibrated confidence. A model can rank a wrong candidate first when the correct structure or sequence is absent from its search space.

title: 碎裂与串联质谱
summary: 理解前体选择、活化及产物离子证据，避免过度推断结构。
text: 选择 → 活化 → 测量 串联质谱（MS/MS）将前体离子与产物离子联系起来。常见实验先隔离一个 m/z 窗口，再活化其中离子，最后测量产物。使用“前体”这一术语时，不应默认窗口中只有一种纯净分子；一个隔离窗口可能包含多个离子物种。 [1] 活化方式改变证据 碰撞诱导解离（CID）通过与气体碰撞来传递能量。HCD 是一种广泛使用的束型碰撞活化实现方式。碎裂模式取决于离子组成、电荷、碰撞能量和仪器条件。不同仪器上的能量数值不一定等价。 电子转移解离（ETD）向多电荷阳离子转移电子，可以产生互补的骨架断裂。其奠基性肽研究展示了不同于碰撞碎裂的途径。 [2] 选择活化方式，就是在选择要收集哪类结构证据。 初识肽段碎片 肽骨架碎片根据保留的末端与断裂位置命名。常见正离子碰撞谱中的 b 离子保留 N 端，y 离子保留 C 端；ETD 常产生 c 和 z 类离子。实际谱图还可能包含中性丢失、内部碎片、多电荷离子及未指认峰。 同一离子系列中相邻单电荷离子的质量差，可以对应氨基酸残基质量。例如，在合适的上下文中，约 71.0371 Da 的差值与丙氨酸残基一致。但它并不能确定完整序列；电荷、离子系列、修饰及容差也必须一致。 计算示例：中性丢失 单电荷前体在 301.1000 附近，单电荷产物在 283.0894 附近，差值为 18.0106，与失水一致。这只提示一种可能的碎裂路径，并非唯一的分子身份。许多结构都能失水。对于保持双电荷的离子，同一中性丢失造成的质荷比变化约为 9.0053。 综合模式，而非只看一个峰 应同时比较多个产物、中性丢失、前体组成和保留行为。离子类型及活化条件匹配时，谱库证据更可靠。NIST 串联质谱库提供与条件相关的参考谱，而不是每个分子的普适谱图。 [3] 无法解释的强峰可能来自共隔离、污染物、其他化学过程或错误候选。不要为了提高匹配分数而悄悄删除它们。同样，预测峰缺失也可能源于检测限或碎裂偏好。 理解检查 一个匹配碎片就能证明候选结构吗？ 不能。需要评价完整证据和合理的替代解释。相关化合物常共享碎片，混合谱也可能产生误导性的组合。 进一步学习 碎裂树、序列数据库检索、谱图预测和从头测序将这些约束形式化。应分别评价候选排序和经校准的置信度。当正确结构或序列不在搜索空间中时，模型也可能把错误候选排在第一位。

title: Read a spectrum step by step
summary: Read an annotated simulated spectrum: infer charge, inspect isotope ratios, and separate narrow peaks from accurate masses.
text: 1. Read the metadata before the peaks Establish polarity, ionization method, scan level, mass range, calibration, retention time, and—when relevant—precursor isolation and collision energy. An EI spectrum, an ESI MS1 spectrum, and a product-ion spectrum require different interpretations. Confirm whether intensities are raw, normalized, or transformed. 2. Group related evidence Look for isotope envelopes and plausible charge spacing. Then consider adduct relationships and shared chromatographic profiles. Check the blank: a prominent background peak may have nothing to do with the target. Keep overlapping isotope envelopes in mind before assigning one charge to a crowded region. Elemental isotope patterns constrain hypotheses. For example, one chlorine atom often produces a characteristic M and M+2 relationship of roughly 3:1, whereas one bromine atom often gives roughly 1:1. Other atoms and overlapping ions complicate these simplified patterns. Consult isotope masses and abundances rather than treating a visual rule as proof. [2] 3. Read an annotated teaching spectrum This is a simulated teaching spectrum, not experimental data. Assume positive-ion MS1, [M+2H] 2+ , a neutral mass of 1000.000000 Da, and N = 50 carbon atoms. Mass and carbon count are abstract model inputs, not a proposed molecular formula. Only carbon isotopes vary, with independent 13 C probability p = 0.0107; all other atoms and added protons are fixed isotopically. Proton mass and carbon isotope inputs come from NIST. [3] [4] Each isotope class has equal response per molecule and a Gaussian profile with FWHM w = 0.010000 on the m/z coordinate scale. We deliberately add +0.002000 to every peak position. There is no noise, baseline, saturation, or interference. Only the first three isotope classes are shown, although the probability model includes higher classes. Simulation, not a measured spectrum. Top: A–C are isotope classes k = 0, 1, 2. Bottom: A enlarged. The orange dashed line marks x_ref; the gray dotted line marks x_obs. The horizontal arrow measures FWHM at 50% height. I/I_A normalizes signal to peak A. Open full-size figure . Simulated positions and relative heights; m/z values rounded to six decimals Peak / ¹³C count k Reference m/z Simulated m/z Height, A = 100 A / 0 501.007276 501.009276 100.000 B / 1 501.508954 501.510954 54.079 C / 2 502.010631 502.012631 14.330 A. Infer the charge from spacing Two successive intervals are about 0.501677. Under the carbon-isotope assumption, n ≈ 1.00335483507 / 0.501677 ≈ 2 . The common additive offset cancels in the interval. Recovering the neutral mass from the shifted A position gives M = (2 × 501.009276467 − 2 × 1.007276467) Da = 1000.004000 Da . The correct charge assignment has not removed the calibration offset. Review the ion-mass formulas . B. Test the isotope ratios The carbon-only binomial model gives P(1)/P(0) = 50 × 0.0107 / 0.9893 ≈ 0.540786 . Thus B is 54.079 relative to A = 100. Similarly, P(2)/P(0) = C(50,2) × (0.0107/0.9893)² ≈ 0.143300 , giving C = 14.330. These are ratios, not percentages of all molecules. Agreement is expected because we generated the figure with this model; it is not independent validation of a chemical formula. C. Separate width from position error Using the unrounded A coordinate, error = 10⁶ × 0.002000 / 501.007276467 ≈ +3.992 ppm . Yet R = 501.009276467 / 0.010000 ≈ 50,101 . The enlarged profile is narrow and displaced at the same time. Read more about accuracy and resolving power . A ±5 ppm window around the reference has half-width about 0.002505. A passes this chosen filter, but passing does not prove identity or perfect calibration. A centroid-only stick plot would not let you measure the illustrated FWHM; it is visible here because we generated profile data. D. State what remains unknown The model contains no retention-time trace, blank, other adducts, or MS/MS evidence. It cannot establish a unique formula, structure, or concentration. In a real spectrum, first test interference and alternative charge/adduct explanations. Isotope patterns from other elements, isotope labeling, and unequal responses can invalidate this simplified calculation. How was the figure calculated? For isotope class k, the reference center is x_k = (1000 + 2h + k × 1.00335483507) / 2, with h = 1.007276467. Add 0.002000 to obtain its plotted center c_k. Heights H_k are 100 × P(k)/P(0). Each curve is I_k(x) = H_k exp[−4 ln(2) ((x−c_k)/w)²], with w = 0.010000; the plotted profile is their sum for k = 0, 1, 2. The model inputs and assumptions and plotting source make the example reproducible. 4. Test candidate explanations Generate formulas within a justified mass tolerance and apply chemically appropriate constraints. Compare predicted isotope patterns and charge/adduct possibilities. Accurate mass can narrow a list, but cannot distinguish all isomers. For MS/MS, ask whether several products and losses agree with the candidate, and whether strong peaks remain unexplained. A compatible spectral library is one source of evidence. Use the correct ion type and acquisition conditions; a top-ranked match can still be wrong if the correct candidate is absent. NIST documents its EI and tandem reference collections. [1] 5. Report the strength of the conclusion Separate observations from interpretations. “Peak observed at 301.0073” is an observation. “Consistent with [M+H] + ” is an ion assignment. A proposed formula and a named structure are progressively stronger claims. Record reference standards, retention evidence, library identifiers, scores, and uncertainties where available. A match to an authentic standard under comparable conditions strengthens an identification. An accurate mass alone supports a much narrower statement. Report unresolved alternatives instead of quietly choosing the most familiar name. Check your understanding Two peaks share retention time. Must they be adducts of the same molecule? No. Unrelated compounds can coelute. A plausible mass relationship and correlated peak shapes help, but further evidence is needed in complex mixtures. Beyond the basics Automated annotation combines mass error, isotope fit, fragmentation, retention, and sometimes ion mobility. These features can be correlated; combining scores without calibration can overstate confidence. Keep candidate generation, ranking, and identification confidence as separate steps.

title: 逐步解读质谱图
summary: 解读带注释的模拟谱图：推断电荷、检查同位素比值，并区分窄峰与准确的质量测量。
text: 1. 看峰之前先看元数据 先确认极性、电离方法、扫描级别、质量范围、校准和保留时间；必要时还要查看前体隔离及碰撞能量。EI 谱、ESI 一级谱和产物离子谱需要不同的解释方式。还要确认强度是原始值、归一化值，还是经过其他变换。 2. 将相关证据分组 寻找同位素包络和合理的电荷间距，再考虑加合物关系及共同的色谱轮廓。检查空白：显著的背景峰可能与目标无关。在拥挤区域赋予电荷前，应考虑重叠的同位素包络。 元素同位素模式可以约束假设。例如，一个氯原子常产生约 3:1 的 M 与 M+2 关系，而一个溴原子常产生约 1:1 的关系。其他原子及重叠离子会使这些简化模式变复杂。应参考同位素质量和丰度，而不是把目测规律当作证明。 [2] 3. 解读带注释的教学谱图 这是一张模拟教学谱图，不是实验数据。 假设为正离子 MS1，离子类型为 [M+2H] 2+ ，中性质量为 1000.000000 Da，碳原子数 N = 50。质量和碳原子数是抽象模型输入，不代表提出了某个分子式。仅碳同位素变化，每个碳原子独立地以 p = 0.0107 的概率为 13 C；其他原子及添加质子均固定同位素。质子质量与碳同位素输入来自 NIST。 [3] [4] 每个同位素类别中单个分子的响应相同，峰形为高斯轮廓，在质荷比坐标尺度上的半峰全宽 w = 0.010000。我们刻意将所有峰的位置增加 +0.002000。模型没有噪声、基线、饱和或干扰。图中只显示前三个同位素类别，尽管概率模型还包括更高类别。 模拟图，并非实测谱图。 上图 A–C 为 k = 0、1、2 的同位素类别；下图放大 A。橙色虚线为 x_ref，灰色点线为 x_obs。水平箭头在 50% 峰高处标示 FWHM。I/I_A 表示相对于峰 A 归一化的信号。 打开完整尺寸图片 。 模拟峰位置及相对峰高；m/z 数值保留六位小数 峰 / ¹³C 数目 k 参考 m/z 模拟 m/z 峰高，A = 100 A / 0 501.007276 501.009276 100.000 B / 1 501.508954 501.510954 54.079 C / 2 502.010631 502.012631 14.330 A. 根据间距推断电荷 两个连续间隔都约为 0.501677。在碳同位素假设下， n ≈ 1.00335483507 / 0.501677 ≈ 2 。共同的加性偏移在求差时抵消。然而，用 已偏移 的 A 位置还原中性质量，会得到 M = (2 × 501.009276467 − 2 × 1.007276467) Da = 1000.004000 Da 。正确的电荷指认并没有消除校准偏移。可复习 离子质量公式 。 B. 检验同位素比值 仅考虑碳的二项分布模型 给出 P(1)/P(0) = 50 × 0.0107 / 0.9893 ≈ 0.540786 。因此，以 A = 100 计，B 为 54.079。同理， P(2)/P(0) = C(50,2) × (0.0107/0.9893)² ≈ 0.143300 ，得到 C = 14.330。这些是比值，并非占全部分子的百分比。因为图本身就是用该模型生成的，所以符合模型是预期结果，不是对分子式的独立验证。 C. 分开评价峰宽和位置误差 使用未舍入的 A 坐标， error = 10⁶ × 0.002000 / 501.007276467 ≈ +3.992 ppm 。同时， R = 501.009276467 / 0.010000 ≈ 50,101 。放大的轮廓峰可以既窄又偏移。详见 准确度与分辨本领 。 参考位置附近 ±5 ppm 窗口的半宽约为 0.002505。A 通过这个选定过滤条件，但通过不等于身份已获证明，也不等于校准完全准确。仅有质心棒图时，无法测量图示 FWHM；本例能看到峰宽，是因为生成了轮廓数据。 D. 说明哪些仍然未知 模型不包含保留时间轨迹、空白、其他加合物或 MS/MS 证据，不能确定唯一分子式、结构或浓度。对真实谱图，应先检验干扰及其他电荷或加合物解释。其他元素的同位素模式、同位素标记或响应不一致，都可能使这个简化计算不再适用。 这张图如何计算？ 同位素类别 k 的参考中心为 x_k = (1000 + 2h + k × 1.00335483507) / 2，其中 h = 1.007276467。加上 0.002000，得到绘图中心 c_k。峰高 H_k 为 100 × P(k)/P(0)。每条曲线为 I_k(x) = H_k exp[−4 ln(2) ((x−c_k)/w)²]，其中 w = 0.010000；图示轮廓为 k = 0、1、2 三条曲线之和。 模型输入与假设 及 绘图源码 可用于复现。 4. 检验候选解释 在有依据的质量容差内生成候选分子式，施加合适的化学约束，并比较预测同位素模式、电荷与加合物。准确质量可以缩小候选范围，但不能区分所有异构体。对 MS/MS，应检查多个产物和丢失是否符合候选，以及是否仍有无法解释的强峰。 兼容的谱库是一种证据来源。应采用正确的离子类型与采集条件；当正确候选缺失时，最高分结果仍可能错误。NIST 提供 EI 和串联参考库的说明。 [1] 5. 报告结论的证据强度 将观测与解释分开。“在 301.0073 观察到峰”是观测；“与 [M+H] + 一致”是离子指认；候选分子式和命名结构则是逐步更强的主张。应记录可用的标准品、保留证据、谱库编号、分数和不确定性。 在相似条件下与真实标准品匹配，可以增强鉴定可信度。仅有准确质量时，能支持的结论范围更有限。应报告尚未排除的候选，而不是默认选择最熟悉的名称。 理解检查 两个峰具有相同保留时间，就一定是同一分子的加合物吗？ 不是。不相关化合物也会共洗脱。合理的质量关系和相关峰形能提供帮助，但复杂混合物中仍需更多证据。 进一步学习 自动注释会结合质量误差、同位素拟合、碎裂、保留时间，有时还包括离子淌度。这些特征可能相关；未经校准就组合分数，容易夸大置信度。应区分候选生成、排序与鉴定置信度。

title: Acquisition: full scan, DDA, DIA & targeted
summary: Choose which evidence to record and understand the consequences for coverage and quantification.
text: Acquisition is a sampling decision A method specifies which ions the instrument measures, when, and with what settings. It affects the evidence available later; software cannot reliably recover evidence that was never acquired. Begin with the analytical question, expected sample complexity, chromatographic peak width, and required selectivity. Compare the main modes Mode Selection logic Interpretation consequence Full-scan MS1 Measure a configured m/z range without deliberate precursor fragmentation. Provides isotope and feature information; generally less direct structural evidence than MS/MS. Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) Select precursors using survey-scan signals and rules such as intensity, charge, and exclusion. Often produces relatively focused MS/MS spectra, but sampling can vary between runs and low-abundance ions may be missed. Data-independent acquisition (DIA) Systematically fragment predefined ranges or use another strategy independent of individual survey-peak selection. Broad repeated sampling produces mixed product signals that require appropriate computational separation and scoring. Targeted SRM/MRM or PRM Monitor selected precursor–product transitions (SRM/MRM), or acquire product spectra for selected precursors (PRM). Focuses measurement time on a defined target set. Interferences, scheduling, and calibration still require validation. Gillet and colleagues demonstrated targeted extraction from systematically acquired DIA fragment data, an influential foundation for SWATH-style proteomics. [1] IUPAC describes selected-reaction monitoring and related terms. [2] Worked example: cycle time A chromatographic peak is about 12 seconds wide. A method with a 1.2-second cycle gives roughly 10 sampling opportunities across that width; a 3-second cycle gives roughly 4. This is a planning estimate, not a universal acceptance threshold. Peak shape, integration, precision goals, and how width is defined all matter. Adding MS/MS scans or DIA windows consumes time. Narrower windows can reduce co-isolation but increase the number of windows needed for the same range. Longer accumulation or transients may improve some measurements while reducing temporal sampling. Design the experiment around the question For exploratory identification, DDA can provide interpretable precursor-focused spectra. For consistent sampling across cohorts, DIA may be useful with suitable analysis. For a validated set of quantitative targets, a targeted method can allocate time efficiently. None of these labels guarantees better data for every sample or objective. Use blanks, pooled quality-control samples where appropriate, standards, and a documented injection sequence. Randomization and blocking can reduce confounding between biology and instrument drift. Record source conditions, scan range, isolation windows, collision energy, cycle timing, and instrument settings. Check your understanding Does DIA mean every molecule will be identified? No. Molecules can be outside the selected range, poorly ionized, below detection, obscured by interference, or unsupported by the analysis model. Systematic acquisition does not guarantee complete identification. Beyond the basics DIA analysis connects precursor and fragment traces across retention time, often using predicted or measured libraries. Evaluate interference handling, confidence calibration, and missing values. When comparing acquisition modes, match sample amount, instrument time, and evaluation criteria so the comparison answers a fair question.

title: 采集：全扫描、DDA、DIA 与靶向
summary: 理解不同采集方式保留的证据，以及对覆盖度和定量的影响。
text: 采集是一种采样决策 采集方法规定仪器在什么时间、用什么参数测量哪些离子。它决定后续可用证据；软件无法可靠地恢复从未采集过的信息。设计时应先明确分析问题、样品复杂度、色谱峰宽及所需选择性。 比较主要模式 模式 选择逻辑 对解释的影响 全扫描 MS1 测量指定质荷比范围，不主动进行前体碎裂。 提供同位素及特征信息，但通常比 MS/MS 缺少直接结构证据。 数据依赖采集（DDA） 根据调查扫描信号及强度、电荷、排除等规则选择前体。 通常得到较集中的 MS/MS 谱，但不同运行间采样可能变化，低丰度离子可能遗漏。 数据非依赖采集（DIA） 系统地碎裂预设范围，或使用不依赖逐个调查峰选择的策略。 广泛重复采样产生混合产物信号，需要合适的计算分离和评分。 靶向 SRM/MRM 或 PRM 监测指定前体–产物离子对（SRM/MRM），或对选定前体采集产物谱（PRM）。 将测量时间集中于明确的目标集合，仍需验证干扰、时间调度与校准。 Gillet 等人展示了从系统采集的 DIA 碎片数据中进行靶向提取的方法，是 SWATH 类蛋白质组学的重要基础。 [1] IUPAC 介绍了选择反应监测等术语。 [2] 计算示例：循环时间 某色谱峰宽约 12 秒。若方法的循环时间为 1.2 秒，则跨该峰宽约有 10 次采样机会；若为 3 秒，则约有 4 次。这是规划估算，并非通用验收阈值。峰形、积分、精密度目标以及峰宽定义都会影响要求。 增加 MS/MS 扫描或 DIA 窗口会消耗时间。更窄的窗口可减少共隔离，但覆盖同一范围需要更多窗口。更长的积累或瞬态信号可能改善某些测量，同时降低时间采样密度。 围绕问题设计实验 探索性鉴定可采用 DDA 获取以前体为中心的谱图。若希望在队列中保持一致采样，配合适当分析的 DIA 可能有用。对于经过验证的定量目标集合，靶向方法可以高效分配时间。但没有一种模式能保证在所有样品与目标上都更好。 应安排空白、适用时的混合质量控制样品、标准品，并记录进样顺序。随机化和分块设计可减少生物学因素与仪器漂移的混杂。记录离子源条件、扫描范围、隔离窗口、碰撞能量、循环时序和仪器参数。 理解检查 DIA 是否意味着所有分子都能被鉴定？ 不是。分子可能超出采集范围、电离不佳、低于检测限、受干扰掩盖，或无法被分析模型解释。系统采集并不保证完整鉴定。 进一步学习 DIA 分析通过保留时间联系前体与碎片轨迹，常利用预测或实测谱库。应评价干扰处理、置信度校准及缺失值。比较不同采集模式时，应匹配样品量、仪器时间和评价标准，使比较回答公平的问题。

title: From raw data to reliable results
summary: Build a reproducible analysis: features, identification, quantification, quality control, and confidence.
text: Keep the analysis layers distinct A raw signal is not an identification, and an identification is not a concentration. A useful workflow preserves the evidence behind each transformation. Archive original files, sample metadata, method settings, software versions, and parameters before processing. Convert and inspect. Check scan counts, retention range, polarity, and MS levels after any conversion. Detect features. Find peaks, group isotope patterns, and connect signals over time. Align or match. Relate comparable features across runs without forcing every signal into a match. Identify or annotate. Test sequence, formula, structure, or library hypotheses. Quantify and evaluate. Integrate signals, inspect controls, and model the intended biological or chemical comparison. Use open formats without losing provenance mzML is a community format for mass-spectrometry spectra and associated acquisition metadata; it is not an identification-results table. HUPO-PSI maintains its specification and controlled vocabulary. [1] ProteoWizard provides tools for working with and converting MS data. [2] Conversion options such as centroiding can change the data representation, so retain originals and document the command and version. Scores are not error rates In peptide database searching, an experimental MS/MS spectrum is compared with candidate peptide spectra under a model of digestion, modifications, and mass tolerances. The highest score is relative to that candidate set. Expanding the search space changes the opportunity for chance matches. Target–decoy strategies use deliberately constructed alternative sequences to estimate incorrect matches under stated assumptions. [3] A reported 1% false discovery rate (FDR) concerns an accepted collection at a specified level; it does not certify each identification as 99% correct. Peptide-spectrum match, peptide, and protein-level error rates are different. Modification-site confidence is another question. Worked example: inspect a result table Suppose a pipeline reports 1,000 accepted peptide-spectrum matches at an estimated 1% FDR. Under an appropriate, well-calibrated procedure, this describes a collection with an estimated false-discovery proportion around that threshold; it does not reveal which individual matches are incorrect or guarantee exactly 10 errors. Filtering to a subgroup afterward may change its error rate. Now suppose a feature has an area of 200,000 in one sample and 100,000 in another. The observed ratio is 2. Before attributing it to concentration, examine normalization, blanks, saturation, integration, internal standards, and batch structure. Distinguish technical repeatability from biological replication. Quality control is part of inference Inspect mass error, retention drift, signal stability, missingness, and control-sample behavior. Missing values may represent low abundance, interference, failed identification, or acquisition choices. Replacing every missing value by zero creates an unsupported assumption. Choose filtering, normalization, and statistical models for the measurement and experimental design. Paths into advanced computation Signal processing: peak fitting, isotope deconvolution, and chromatographic alignment. Identification: database search, de novo sequencing, fragmentation trees, and spectral prediction. DIA analysis: trace extraction, interference modeling, and confidence estimation. Machine learning: calibration and evaluation on genuinely held-out experiments. Prevent leakage by separating related peptides, compounds, samples, or batches as appropriate to the question. Keep preprocessing fitted on training data when evaluating prediction. Report the split, candidate universe, metrics, and failure cases. A high benchmark score is meaningful only in the context of that design. Check your understanding Can a low FDR replace experimental quality controls? No. Identification error control does not detect every sampling, quantification, contamination, or study-design problem. Both statistical and experimental checks are needed.

title: 从原始数据到可靠结果
summary: 构建可复现的分析：特征、鉴定、定量、质量控制和置信度。
text: 区分分析层次 原始信号不是鉴定结果，鉴定结果也不是浓度。合理的流程应保留每次转换背后的证据。处理前，保存原始文件、样品元数据、仪器方法、软件版本和参数。 转换与检查。 任何格式转换后，都应检查扫描数、保留时间范围、极性和 MS 级别。 检测特征。 寻找峰、对同位素模式分组，并沿时间连接信号。 对齐或匹配。 关联不同运行间可比较的特征，不强迫所有信号都匹配。 鉴定或注释。 检验序列、分子式、结构或谱库假设。 定量与评价。 积分信号、检查对照，并对目标生物学或化学比较建模。 使用开放格式并保留来源 mzML 是用于质谱谱图及相关采集元数据的社区格式，并非鉴定结果表。HUPO-PSI 维护其规范和受控词汇。 [1] ProteoWizard 提供处理与转换质谱数据的工具。 [2] 质心化等选项可能改变数据表示，因此应保留原始文件，并记录命令和软件版本。 分数不等于错误率 在肽数据库检索中，实验 MS/MS 谱与候选肽谱在酶切、修饰和质量容差等模型下比较。最高分是相对于候选集合而言的。扩展搜索空间会改变随机匹配机会。 目标–诱饵策略通过刻意构造的替代序列，在一定假设下估计错误匹配。 [3] 报告 1% 错误发现率（FDR），针对的是指定层次上的已接受结果集合，并不保证每个鉴定都有 99% 正确概率。肽谱匹配、肽和蛋白质层次的错误率不同；修饰位点定位置信度也是另一问题。 应用示例：检查结果表 假设流程在估计 1% FDR 阈值下接受 1,000 个肽谱匹配。在适用且校准合理的程序下，这描述的是一个估计错误发现比例在该阈值附近的集合；它不能指出哪些匹配错误，也不保证恰好有 10 个错误。之后再筛选子集，可能改变子集错误率。 再假设某特征在两个样品中的峰面积分别为 200,000 和 100,000，观测比值为 2。将它归因于浓度前，应检查归一化、空白、饱和、积分、内标及批次结构，并区分技术重复性和生物学重复。 质量控制是推断的一部分 检查质量误差、保留时间漂移、信号稳定性、缺失情况和质控样品表现。缺失值可能代表低丰度、干扰、鉴定失败或采集选择。把所有缺失值替换为零会引入未经支持的假设。应根据测量特点与实验设计选择过滤、归一化和统计模型。 进入高级计算方法的路径 信号处理： 峰拟合、同位素去卷积和色谱对齐。 鉴定： 数据库检索、从头测序、碎裂树和谱图预测。 DIA 分析： 轨迹提取、干扰建模和置信度估计。 机器学习： 校准，并在真正独立的实验数据上评价。 根据研究问题，适当分开相关肽、化合物、样品或批次以防止数据泄漏。评价预测模型时，需要拟合的预处理应只使用训练数据。报告数据划分、候选全集、指标及失败案例。高基准分数只有在具体设计背景下才有意义。 理解检查 低 FDR 能代替实验质量控制吗？ 不能。鉴定错误控制无法发现所有采样、定量、污染或实验设计问题。统计检查和实验检查都不可缺少。
